organization.name: Avarok Cybersecurity
organization.description: Avarok Cybersecurity builds post-quantum security and infrastructure software in Rust: the open-source Citadel Protocol SDK and the products built on it.

founder.name: Thomas Braun
founder.description: AI inference innovator and Rust expert. Founder of Atlas Cybernetics and creator of the Atlas Inference Engine, plus The Citadel Protocol and Avarok Cybersecurity.

crawlers.//: robots.txt policy. Search and answer-engine crawlers are named so the policy is explicit; training crawlers stay allowed, as in the previous robots.txt, until the owner decides otherwise.

products.name: Citadel Workspace
products.oneLiner: A post-quantum collaborative workspace: messages, calls, files and live documents travel directly between people, end-to-end encrypted.
products.description: Citadel Workspace is a collaborative workspace in which every message, file and call is end-to-end encrypted with post-quantum cryptography and travels directly between people rather than through a server that could read it.
products.os: Web browser (installable PWA), with the Citadel Agent on macOS, Linux or Windows

products.name: Citadel Protocol SDK
products.oneLiner: An open-source Rust SDK for post-quantum, end-to-end encrypted client-server and peer-to-peer networking, with NAT traversal built in.
products.description: The Citadel Protocol is a post-quantum secure networking protocol and Rust SDK (citadel_sdk) for building client-server and peer-to-peer applications, with built-in NAT traversal, multi-layered ratcheting and a remote encrypted virtual filesystem.

products.name: Citadel Agent
products.oneLiner: The local daemon (citadeld) that manages Citadel Protocol connections, so several apps on one machine can use them without embedding the SDK.
products.description: The Citadel Agent (citadeld) is a local daemon that manages the lifecycle of Citadel Protocol connections and exposes them to local applications over a lightweight IPC interface, so several apps can share the protocol without embedding the SDK.

products.name: synchronized.work
products.oneLiner: Cross-person coordination for coding agents: one live tree of projects, tasks, people, agents and progress, with post-quantum signed prompts.
products.description: synchronized.work is an open-source coordination service that lets many people's coding agents share one live task tree (Project, Task, Person, Agent, Progress) and receive post-quantum signed prompts, with Sign in with Citadel.

products.name: Atlas Inference
products.oneLiner: An open-source, pure Rust and CUDA LLM inference engine, hand-tuned for NVIDIA DGX Spark, with an OpenAI-compatible API.
products.description: Atlas is an open-source, pure Rust and CUDA LLM inference engine hand-tuned for NVIDIA DGX Spark, with an OpenAI-compatible API and published, reproducible benchmarks.
products.os: Linux (NVIDIA DGX Spark; AMD Strix Halo)

products.name: CertifiedCopy
products.oneLiner: Export iPhone and Mac text messages to PDF, CSV, JSON or RSMF in your browser, with a SHA-256 record of the source file. Nothing is uploaded.
products.description: CertifiedCopy exports iPhone and Mac text messages to PDF, CSV, JSON or RSMF with a SHA-256 record of the source file, and runs entirely in the browser, so nothing is uploaded.
products.os: Any modern browser; a signed and notarised Mac app
